statements.summary_en: (opinion) The biggest debate on the stock is the gap between $71m quarterly AI Cloud revenue, $1bn operating ARR and $4bn contracted for year-end; last quarter's disappointment came from ramp assumptions ahead of guidance, which is on IREN to manage better (specific sites, tighter windows)
statements.quote: Some disappointment with last quarter traces to ramp assumptions that ran ahead of anything we guided.

statements.summary_ko: (의견) AI 발전 속도를 늦추자는 논의는 다음 세대 모델 이야기일 뿐, 지금 모델만 보급해도 수년간 컴퓨팅이 모자란다고 봄. 공급은 HBM 메모리와 전력이 연결된 건물이 막고 있어 수요 위험은 위쪽, 공급 위험은 '덜 지어지는' 쪽이라고 말함
statements.summary_en: (opinion) Calls to slow frontier AI are about future models; rolling out today's models alone needs more compute than the world can build for years. Supply is capped by HBM memory and powered buildings, so demand risk skews up and supply risk skews to less capacity
statements.quote: The risk to demand continues to seem heavily weighted to the upside.

statements.summary_ko: (의견) GPU 자금 조달 방식을 설명: 고객 선수금(최근 3년 계약은 GPU 비용의 45~55%) + GPU 담보 대출(Microsoft 건 A등급 약 6%로 선수금과 합쳐 96%, 매켄지 건 9% 고정). 데이터센터는 지금까지 빚 없이 현금으로 지었고 2026년 용량은 대부분 팔렸다고 말함
statements.summary_en: (opinion) Explained how IREN funds GPUs: customer prepayments (45–55% of GPU capex on recent 3-year deals) plus GPU-secured debt (Microsoft: A-rated ~6%, 96% covered together; Mackenzie: 9% fixed). Data centers built from cash with no debt so far; 2026 largely sold out
statements.quote: Construction has been funded from cash to date, with no debt against these multi-billion dollar assets.
